items.title: Genetic engineering ki do bunyadi technologies (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the two basic technologies of genetic engineering (PDF 155).

blocks.text: Genetic engineering mein scientists do bunyadi technologies par bharosa karte hain:

items: Recombinant DNA Technology: aik jandar ke DNA ka tukra kaat kar nikalna aur use doosre jandar ke DNA mein "chipka" (paste) dena.
Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR): DNA ke bohat chhote hisse (segment) ko tezi se barha kar (amplify kar ke) bari miqdar mein bana dena.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Recombinant DNA technology aisi hai jaise aik document se jumla kaat kar doosre document mein chipka dena; PCR aisi hai jaise aik safhe ki photocopy machine se baar baar copies nikalna.

blocks.prompt: Jurm ki jagah se mila DNA bohat thora ho to us ki laakhon copies banane ke liye kaun si technology use hogi?
blocks.explanation: PCR, kyun ke yeh DNA ke chhote se hisse ko tezi se bari miqdar mein barha deti hai.

items: Recombinant DNA technology: aik jandar ka DNA kaat kar doosre ke DNA mein jorna.
PCR: DNA ke chhote hisse ki tezi se bohat si copies banana.
